outcome.summary: First paid baseline preparation is complete: final-image DSH rehearsals, same-ledger proposal handoff, source provenance, finite manifests and all local gates pass. Actual paid approvals remain pending.

what_worked: Both exact-model DSH protocol rehearsals perform a successful tool call and finish without provider keys or egress.
The business oracle correctly rejects the intentional no-op fixture rather than fabricating success.
Rollout and proposal reservations share one durable campaign/provider cap.
Manifest verification rejects stale source/image artifacts and does not manufacture approval.
what_failed: Initial rehearsal exposed missing runtime flags, SDK wire-field mismatch, background title calls, plugin insertion and compressed-session decoding issues; all were resolved before the final rehearsal.
Review found rehearsal contamination, alternate ledger roots and stale-build provenance risks; isolated stores, input rejection, fixed roots and verified build provenance resolve them.
A raw Docker image ID was interpreted as a registry tag during build; a locally verified content-named base tag resolves the build without pulling model dependencies.
